content: This paper presents a new methodology for simultaneously performing feature selection and classification of functional data with categorical responses, particularly relevant for longitudinal healthcare data from sources like wearables. The approach addresses a novel optimization problem by integrating logistic loss and functional features, utilizing functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to efficiently identify crucial features in high-dimensional scenarios.
